desc:
❄️ Frost Convoy: a co-op winter survival game with your sled dogs! Survive snowy nights, scare wolves with your torch, beat the Yeti and KEEP THE FIRE ALIVE! 🔥

🎃 HAUNTED AURORA (16 Oct - 2 Nov)
👻 Scare 25 ghost wolves to win the Pumpkin dog coat, free!

☀️ BY DAY: ride your dog sled, find crates, load the convoy
🌙 BY NIGHT: feed the fire, keep the wolves away
👑 Bosses: the Great Yeti, the Spider Queen, the Goblin Chief

🐶 YOUR DOG
🦴 Feed, pet and play fetch with your husky every day

🆕 THE LODGE
⛸️ Ice rink: skate, Ring Rush, hockey and snowballs
🎣 Ice fishing · 🐕 Dog Dash races · 📋 daily goals

🧭 3 WAYS TO PLAY
🔥 Short Haul: 5 nights
🌙 Long Road North: 100 nights, 20 chapters
🌌 Endless: how long can you survive?
🧱 Build your camp, craft better torches and parkas

❄️ FROST PASS · SEASON 1
🎁 30 levels, a free reward on each. Pass looks: dog coats, torch flames, sled colours

🏆 Leaderboards · 👥 Play solo with bots or with friends! 💙
